tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// yid lhung lha rgyal srang gi gtsug lag khang srid gsum dge legs yongs 'du zhes bya ba'i phyi nang gi gtan 'jog dngos po'i deb ther rang gzhan yid ches skyed pa'i bden dpang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta gsum bsngags la ngo mtshar che ba'i rtogs byed kyi dgongs pa nyis stong zhe brgyad mchis pa yang ba'i bya ba gcig yang ba gcig rjes 'brang yi ge nyis khri nyis stong zhe brgyad/ lci yang so so chig khri chig stong nyer gnyis/ phyi mo sum khri sum stong re drug a dh+wa 'phred rta yig steng 'og bzhi stong go lnga mchis pa'i nang gsel naṣ+ṭa dang ud+diṣ+ṭa chig stong nyis brgya nga brgyad pa nye dbang rdo rje zhes bya ba'i prastā ras bcings pa'o//

༄༅// sukalpasatwony+ratrakaṣas+sahasrat+karobhibud+dh+yapraṇidhānukūlaṃkarergatedwādashakāyiyogoḥnamamunīn+t+rāyaphalash+tsahetuḥ ༄༅// skal bzang sems dpa' stong las snyigs ma 'dir// mngon par 'tshang rgya'i smon lam rjes mthun par// bcu gnyis mdzad pas lus can byang chub kyi// rgyu 'bras la sbyor thub pa'i dbang por 'dud// gangs can bstan pa'i snang mdzad mang byon yang*// rgyal bas lung bstan kun dga' bzang 'dra su// mkha' dbyings mi ltung phreng ba grangs med du// ku mud bzhad pa'i rtsa lag ma mchis so// gang de'i bstan pa'i rgyal thabs chen po la// 'phags nor rin chen bdun la dbang 'byor ba'i// sku gsum mi 'gyur rgyal tshab 'khor los sgyur// bkra shis dge mtshan bye bas dbang bskur ba// theg gsum chos kyi phrin las khengs ldan 'dis// rgya mtsho'i mur thug song ba'i khongs de na// bdag cag rnams kyi bsti gnas phrogs so zhes// mda' lnga'i dpung tshogs shugs ring 'byin nam snyam// mgon de sa skyong bsod nams shing rtar brten// lha de'i rigs kyi cod paṇa thob pa dang*// lhan cig chab 'bangs kyis mtshon skye 'gro yis// mgon skyabs rten gling mchog tu skal bas thob// kun dga' zung gi lugs bzang sangs rgyas dang*// dgongs pa gcig tu dpyad gsum gyis grub pa// klog spong 'khor lo mkhas pa'i tshul gsum gyis// lus can bsod nams mgron du ring gnas phyir// gang tshe bstan 'gror phan par dgongs pa'i rgyur// sbyor bkod phun tshogs mthun rkyen sbyar bar brten// chos sde gtsug lag khang bzang rten brten pa'i// srid gsum dge legs yongs 'du'i dpag bsam bskrun// gnas der rten gsum mchod pa'i yo byad dang*// sgrub mchod dge 'dun bsdu ba'i nyer mkho'i rigs// gtan 'jog kun gyi dngos ming rnam grangs bzhin// rnam gsal yi ge'i me long 'di na bskrun// de'ang rang re rnams kyi ston pa mnyam med bu ram shing pa de sras rgyal tshab rim par byon pa rnams kyi ring lugs dpyad pa gsum gyis rnam par dag pa 'di nyid ring du gnas pa'i thabs la 'bad pa gtso bor bya dgos te/

mgon po byams pas/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'du// legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel bcas// de yi dbang gi shākya'i bstan pa ni// 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas su 'byung ba de 'dzin skyes bu dang dge 'dun gyi klog spong gi 'khor lo'am bshad sgrub kyi bgyi ba la rag las shing de la'ang bslu med skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog gsum la mchod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bya ba thos bsam bsgom gsum dang*/ bshad sgrub kyi spyod pa dri med skyong ba las thabs gzhan 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin zhing*/ de la brten nas 'jig rten gyi khams phan bde 'dzad pa med pa'i gter la longs spyod pa'i skal ba sbom por 'gyur ba ni nges pa nyid do// tshul de dag la dgongs nas rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po zhes mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa'i grags snyan gyi yi ge rnga gsang srid pa gsum gyi khongs na ldir ba gong de'i rgyal tshab chos kyi khri la zhabs zung gi chu skyes rnam par bkod de/ mkhas pa'i bgyi ba rnam pa gsum gyi chos dang sems can dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad/ slar mtshungs pa med pa'i stobs kyis tha gru rnam par yangs pa'i chab srid dge ba bcu dang rjes su mthun pa'i bka' khrims gser gyi 'khor lo'i mnga' sgyur ba'i lhas bskos rgyal po blo gros rgya mtsho pa lcam dral gyis rigs kyi gcod pan gcig pu nyid du thob par brten/ mi dman bsod nams gser gyi shing rtas drangs te/ bod chen ljongs kyi skye 'gro dpag tu med pa'i mgon skyabs su thob pa'i skal ba bzang po la sbyar/ gang de'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rtogs brjod rin chen 'byung gnas chen po'i co 'drir bzod pa las skabs 'dir bstan 'gror phan pa'i thugs bskyed zab cing yangs par yid lhung lha rgyal srang du dge 'dun 'du ba'i chos sde chen po gan+dho la rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar bskrun gnang ba la/

slar yang*/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis/ gtsug lag khang rnams rgyal ba'i sku gzugs dang*// dam chos glegs bam du mas rab mdzes shing*// lha rdzas mchod pa'i sprin tshogs dpag med kyis// mchod pa'i char chen rgyas par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rten gsum mchod pa'i yo byad dang*/ der lhag pa'i lha rnams kyi dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba'i nyer spyad dngos rdzas kyi gtan 'jog ji snyed bzhag pa rnams 'thor gong du btang mi btub pa'i dpang por mi 'gyur phreng ba'i yi ge'i me long du gsal bar 'god pa la/ thog mar gtsug lag khang du sogs bri/ de ltar gtsug lag khang chen zhol khang dang bcas pa'i steng shod dang*/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i rten gsum mchod rdzas kyi yo byad nas brtsams te dkon mchog mchod 'bul dang dge 'dun bsnyen bkur gyi khyad du dgos pa'i dngos rdzas gtan 'jog tu bzhag pa 'di rnams 'thor 'god brlag stor du ma song ba dang*/ spyi rdzas rtsis sprod du bzhag pa 'di dag slan chad las 'dzin byed pa'i bla ma slob dpon su zhig bsko bzhag byed pa gang tshe gcig nas gcig tu yi ge 'di nang ltar tshang rgyas su dpal sde dge sa skyong chen po rim byon gyi sku tshab gtsor bzhugs kyi las 'dzin gsar rnying rtsis sprod bya ba dang*/ slar yang chos kyi sbyin bdag dad pa'i nor can gzhan dang gzhan dag nas 'phan bla bre mchod rdzas sogs gtan bzhag gsar 'phar byung ba rnams kyang las 'dzin de dang de la byung ba'i tho zur bkod mi bdag chen pos bka' tham gyis mtshon pa bcas grangs tshad du bzhag dgos te/ spyir chos sde gtsug lag khang gi gtan 'jog dang bcas pa 'di dag bskrun pa na/ e waṃ pa'i mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba nyid nas/ khe dang grag 'dod phyogs lhung gi phyir ma yin pa rab tu byung ba rnams 'du ba'i gtsug lag khang rang rang gi bsti gnas spyod lam rung ba'i khang phran med par gar thod thod du gyi nar 'phyan pas khyim pa sogs ma dad pa dang*/

rab tu byung ba rnams kyi spyod lam zhugs tshul 'di lta bu'o// zhes gzhan gyis gshe ba dang 'phya ba gyur pa'i 'khor rnam bzhis bca' khrims byed pa po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la gshe ba dang dpyas gdags par 'gro bas de la brten nas rang gzhan sems can mang po'i rgyud la mnar med dmyal bar 'gro ba'i rgyu sdig pa stobs chen sog par 'gyur ba dang*/ mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po bstan pa'i sbyin bdag du bcas pa la'ang*/ chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ka'i bka' khrims ma mchis zhes bshung ba'i gnod tshabs de la che ba ci zhig de mthun dgon pa'i grwa tshogs rnams la'ang grags pa mi snyan pa 'byung ba dang*/ gson gshin gyi ched du bsnyen bkur stob pa'i sbyin bdag rnams kyang yid the tshom dang brnyas sems skye ba sogs rgyu mtshan du mas sdig pa mi sog pa'i ched du rgyu rdzas sbyor bkod phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa yin pas tshul de dag la dgongs te mi bdag chen po sku tshab pa las 'dzin gsar rnying do dam pa thams cad nas rtsis sprod len rang gzhan thams cad yid ches par dgos rgyu'i/ mkhan chen thams cad gzigs pa nas deb yig bzhag pa bskal pa nam gnas bar du mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rang bzhin du/ sa skyong chos rgyal chen po nas bka' tham rin po ches mtshan pa 'di la thams cad nas bag yod rtsi 'jog dgos pa'i gtan tshig lags so// smras pa/ tshad dang mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i rten gsum dang*// dge 'dun 'du ba'i kun dga' rwa ba rnams// bskrun pa'i phan yon bsam brjod yul 'das su// rgyal ba'i gsung gis lan gcig mtshan par bsngags// kun gzigs dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba nyid// dus 'dir ngur smrig 'chang tshul rgyal ba'i sras// dpag yas spyod pas 'gro ba byang chub lam// dngos dang rgyud nas 'khrid mdzad shar chen rje// gang gi rtogs brjod nam mkha'i mthar 'byams las// bstan dang sems can phan dgongs gtsug lag khang*// chos sder bcas pa'i kun phan rgyu skar tshogs// sa la bkram lta'i ngo mtshar bkod pa 'dir// gtan 'jog kun gyi dngos btags gsal bas ming*// dngos rdzas bde blag nyid du ston pas tshig

/mi 'gyur bskal par bsnyad pas yi ge nyid// rang gzhan yid ches byed pa'i bden dpang 'dir// gang dag 'khod dgu'i gtan 'jog ji snyed rnams// rdo rje gur mgon dral lcam gdong bzhi pa// dmag zor beg gdong lcam dral bstan srung la// bcol lo gtad do bsrung spel thub par gyis// 'di bgyis dge ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dir// dge 'dun 'grig pa'i rdza rnga grangs med 'du// dkon mchog mchod pa'i sprin gyi gnam sa khengs// bsnyen bkur chu klung bye ba rtag 'bab shog /bstan pa'i snang byed brtse chen e waṃ pa'i// bstan 'dzin mkhas pa'i phrin las ches cher rgyas// bstan pa'i rjes 'jug 'dus pas sa steng khyab// bstan pa'i bshad sgrub phyogs su rgyas gyur cig /ces yid lhung lha rgyal srang gi gtsug lag khang gi srid gsum dge legs yongs 'du zhes bya ba'i phyi nang gi gtan 'jog dngos po'i deb ther rang gzhan yid ches skyed pa'i bden dpang zhes bya ba 'di ni/ shar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' lung phrin las kyi kha lo bsgyur chen pa bla ma shes rab bzang po pa'i gsung bskul dri za'i gling du lta bu'i sog pa'i ngor 'dren mchog dam pa'i legs gsung gi bdud rtsi'i 'tsho ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas bris pa swasti bi dza yan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
